text.EN: Hold here. Don't rush it.
text.TL: Dito muna. Huwag padalos-dalos.

text.EN: Wait for them to thin out before making a move.
text.TL: Hintaying mabawasan sila bago gumalaw.

text.EN: Stay in position. Let's see which way they drift.
text.TL: Manatili sa pwesto. Tingnan kung saan sila papunta.

text.EN: Hold your ground and observe their path.
text.TL: Hawakan ang pwesto at bantayan ang ruta nila.

text.EN: No sudden movements. Let them pass if possible.
text.TL: Walang biglaang galaw. Hayaang lumampas kung maaari.

text.EN: Keep calm and hold the line right here.
text.TL: Kumalma at hawakan ang linya dito.

text.EN: Patience. Let's wait for the right opening.
text.TL: Pasensya muna. Hintayin ang tamang puwang.

text.EN: Hold steady. We decide when we have better information.
text.TL: Maging matatag. Magpapasya tayo kapag mas marami nang impormasyon.

text.EN: Don't panic. Hold position behind cover.
text.TL: Huwag mag-panic. Manatili sa likod ng kublihan.

text.EN: Steady now. Let's assess before we commit.
text.TL: Dahan-dahan lang. Timbangin muna bago sumugod.

text.EN: Stay together. Let's hold before we commit.
text.TL: Magkakasama tayo. Humawak muna bago sumugod.

text.EN: Breathe easy, friend. We hold right here by each other.
text.TL: Huminga ka nang maluwag, kaibigan. Hawak-kamay tayo rito.

text.EN: I'm right beside you. Let's wait for a safe moment.
text.TL: Nasa tabi mo lang ako. Hintayin natin ang ligtas na sandali.

text.EN: Hold steady, partner. We don't have to rush into danger.
text.TL: Magpakatatag ka, kasama. Di natin kailangang magpadalos-dalos.

text.EN: Stay low with me. Let's watch their movements together.
text.TL: Yumuko ka kasabay ko. Sabay nating bantayan ang galaw nila.

text.EN: Keep calm. As long as we hold together, we'll be fine.
text.TL: Manatiling kalmado. Hangga't magkasama tayo, magiging maayos tayo.

text.EN: Just hold on for a minute. Let the worst of the herd pass.
text.TL: Sandali lang. Hayaang lumampas ang pinakamalaking kawan.

text.EN: Steady, friend. I'm right here with you in the quiet.
text.TL: Dahan-dahan, kaibigan. Narito lang ako kasama mo sa katahimikan.

text.EN: Don't be scared. We hold this spot until we have a clean shot.
text.TL: Huwag kang matakot. Hawakan ang pwesto hanggang may malinaw na daan.

text.EN: Together and steady. Let's let them drift away.
text.TL: Sama-sama at matatag. Hayaan natin silang lumayo.

text.EN: Hold. Watch them.
text.TL: Hawak. Bantayan sila.

text.EN: Hold position.
text.TL: Hawakan ang pwesto.

text.EN: Wait.
text.TL: Teka.

text.EN: Stay low.
text.TL: Yumuko.

text.EN: Steady.
text.TL: Magpakatatag.

text.EN: Do not move.
text.TL: Huwag gagalaw.

text.EN: Hold.
text.TL: Hawak.

text.EN: Patience.
text.TL: Pasensya.

text.EN: Freeze.
text.TL: Tigil.

text.EN: Quiet. Watch.
text.TL: Tahimik. Magmasid.

text.EN: No rush. Hold position and watch the pressure.
text.TL: Walang pagmamadali. Humawak at bantayan ang galaw nila.

text.EN: Hold here. If you twitch, you draw the whole pack.
text.TL: Dito muna. Kapag kumilos ka, mahahatak mo ang buong kawan.

text.EN: Stay rooted. Wait until their lead walkers pass.
text.TL: Manatiling nakatuntong. Hintaying lumampas ang nauuna.

text.EN: Maintain silence and hold the corner.
text.TL: Panatilihin ang katahimikan at hawakan ang kanto.

text.EN: Do not engage prematurely. Let the herd scatter.
text.TL: Huwag aatake nang maaga. Hayaang maghiwa-hiwalay ang kawan.

text.EN: Hold your breath if you have to, but don't move.
text.TL: Pigilin ang hininga kung kailangan, pero huwag gagalaw.

text.EN: We wait for an exploitable mistake. Stay still.
text.TL: Hintayin natin ang pagkakamali nila. Huwag gumalaw.

text.EN: Keep your weapon ready, but do not fire yet. Hold.
text.TL: Ihanda ang armas, pero huwag munang puputok. Hawak.

text.EN: Hold tight against the wall. Let them walk past.
text.TL: Dumikit sa pader. Hayaang maglakad sila palampas.

text.EN: Steady. Any sound will turn this into a slaughterhouse.
text.TL: Dahan-dahan. Anumang ingay ay gagawin itong katayan.
